title: Customer's Success Story | Cadeau Plus & Customily with Amazon Custom
summary: Learn how Cadeau Plus automated Amazon Custom Fulfillment and saved hundreds of hours with Customily.
body_markdown:
**Cadeau Plus** sells personalized gifts across the US, UK, and Europe. By automating the file side of **Amazon Custom** orders with[Customily](https://www.customily.com/) , the team handles peak-season volume without manual design work or fulfillment delays.


## About Cadeau Plus


**Cadeau Plus** started with one idea: gifts that carry personal meaning. From day one, the brand built its catalog around personalized, high-quality print-on-demand products. That was a deliberate way to stand out, and it lets **Cadeau Plus** offer one-of-a-kind items for holidays and special occasions.


*“We started with personalized products from day one to set our business apart and establish a unique edge”* says Ms. Huyen. The brand has since grown into major markets including the US, the UK, and Europe.


### What Cadeau Plus Sells


Browse the **Cadeau Plus** store on Amazon and the personalization is the point. The catalog covers t-shirts, mugs, canvas prints, and cushions, with illustrated characters that customers can make their own: names, family members, even pets. A mug reads “This cat mom belongs to” above three cartoon cats, a canvas shows a grandmother with her granddaughters inside a heart, and a cushion features a dad surrounded by his kids. Many designs carry French text and humor.


The store is organized around the way people actually shop for gifts. Shoppers can browse by recipient (mom, dad, grandma, grandpa, dog lovers, cat lovers, couples, best friends) or by occasion, with a section of recommendations that includes retirement gifts, sisters, and teachers. It’s easy to see why the team says these products create “a meaningful emotional connection between the giver and the receiver.”


### Why Cadeau Plus Expanded to Amazon


**Amazon** was the next step for reaching more customers. The team points to three things:


- **Global reach:** access to buyers across North America and Europe.
- **High buyer intent:** shoppers on Amazon arrive ready to purchase.
- **Peak-season traffic:** strong organic visibility during the holidays.


Selling on **Amazon** also helped Cadeau Plus build brand trust and offer fast, reliable fulfillment.


## The Challenge: Basic Tools and Manual Work


Before **Customily** , **Cadeau Plus** used other personalization apps. They worked, but they were limited. *“The apps were quite basic and inflexible, which forced us to do a lot of manual work”* Ms. Huyen explains.


For a business built on[personalization](https://www.customily.com/our-features) , manual work means someone setting up designs and handling each order by hand. That is fine at low volume. It becomes a serious bottleneck when order volume surges, which is exactly what happens on Amazon during peak season.


### Why Cadeau Plus Chose Customily


Cadeau Plus needed a personalization tool that was powerful, stable, and able to fit into the existing workflow. Two things made **Customily** the choice:


1. **Templates that work with Amazon Custom.** Customily templates integrate smoothly with Amazon Custom listings.
2. **A fully automated, two-way API.** Order details go from Amazon to Customily, and print-ready production files come back into Cadeau Plus’s system.


*“It completely eliminates manual handling, accelerates fulfillment launches, and minimizes production errors”* says Ms. Huyen.


## The Results


**Peak season without the panic.** **Customily** automatically renders production files from Amazon orders. *‍*


***“Customily has completely transformed how we run Amazon Custom listings”*** Ms. Huyen says. *“The automated rendering of production files from Amazon orders allows us to handle high order volumes effortlessly during peak seasons without fulfillment delays.”*


**Hundreds of hours saved.** Cadeau Plus keeps its exact figures confidential, but the impact is clear. **Customily** removed the manual design and order setup work, saving the team hundreds of hours. That time now goes into driving sales, with confidence that the workflow can scale with any surge in orders.


**Fewer production errors.** With order data flowing straight into print-ready files, there are fewer manual steps where mistakes can creep in.


### What’s Behind Cadeau Plus’s Success


Ms. Huyen credits a combination of three things: *“meticulous market research, a dedication to product quality, and a continuous drive to optimize our workflows and elevate our standards.”* Pair that mindset with automation tools like **Customily** , she adds, and the team can efficiently deliver unique products across global marketplaces.


## Looking Ahead


Ms. Huyen expects the next few years to bring tougher competition on global e-commerce platforms, rising logistics costs, and fast-shifting consumer trends. Her view: *“We see these as opportunities to innovate further.”*


### Advice for New Sellers


*“Focus heavily on product quality, understand your target audience deeply, and don’t hesitate to invest in the right software tools early on. Automation and efficient workflows are key to scaling sustainably.”*


## Cadeau Plus Isn’t the Only Seller Seeing Results


Cadeau Plus’s experience reflects a wider pattern. Here is what[Customily’s production data](https://www.customily.com/post/amazon-product-personalizer-data) shows for Amazon from May through October, 2026.


##### **Four months live on Amazon**


- **33.9k personalized orders placed** by Amazon shoppers. Print-ready files were generated automatically for each one.
- **8.3k Amazon listings connected** to Customily templates, covering 11.7k ASIN variants.
- **63 Amazon seller accounts connected** to Customily.


##### **Sellers are running real volume**


Two sellers (anonymized) show what this looks like in practice:


- **Seller A** has processed 17k orders since May 2026 across two Amazon stores. They peaked at 6,000 orders in June and now run at about 3,500 a month.
- **Seller B** has processed 12k orders since May and grew every month, from 700 orders in May to 4,500 in August.


Order volume on **Amazon** moves with seasons and promotions, as Seller A’s curve shows. The workflow stays the same when it does. Whether a seller handles 700 orders or 6,000, **Customily** generates the production files the same way, with no one setting up designs by hand.


##### **One integration, two ways to personalize**


Sellers can use **Customily** on **Amazon** in two ways:


- **Pre-purchase:** the buyer personalizes on the listing with Amazon Custom, and Customily turns each order into print-ready files automatically.
- **Post-purchase:** after checkout, Customily sends the buyer a personalization link, then generates the print-ready files.


Pre-purchase made up the larger share of personalized items every month, from 78% in May and 83% in July to 61% so far in October. Post-purchase has grown, reaching 46% in September and 39% in the first week of October. Sellers are mixing both models, and both run through the same integration.
